Name: Doctor
Description: Diagnose, treat, and manage patient care across hospitals, clinics, and speciality centres.
EducationPath: Choose PCB in Classes 11-12, clear NEET-UG, complete MBBS, then pursue internship and optional MD/MS specialization.
RoadmapSteps: Choose PCB in Classes 11-12.
Prepare for NEET-UG for undergraduate medical admission.
Complete MBBS with internship and build strong clinical fundamentals.
After MBBS, consider NEET-PG or INI-CET for MD/MS specialization, then build experience in hospitals or clinics.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 6-9 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen clinical diagnosis and empathy can move toward the upper end of INR 6-25 LPA.
Demand is very high across hospitals, clinics, and speciality centres in India.
Interests: Discovering how the human body works

Name: Dentist
Description: Treat oral health issues, improve dental hygiene, and perform restorative procedures.
EducationPath: Take PCB in Classes 11-12, qualify NEET-UG, complete BDS, and build clinical experience or specialization.
RoadmapSteps: Take PCB in Classes 11-12.
Prepare for NEET-UG for BDS admission.
Complete BDS with clinical postings and internship.
Build hands-on experience in dental clinics or hospitals; consider NEET-MDS later if you want postgraduate specialization.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 4-7 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen manual precision and patient care can move toward the upper end of INR 4-12 LPA.
Demand is high across dental clinics, hospitals, and private practice in India.
TopColleges: Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences

Name: Nurse
Description: Support treatment, monitor patients, and coordinate day-to-day clinical care.
EducationPath: Study PCB, complete B.Sc Nursing or GNM, register with the state nursing council, and gain hospital experience.
RoadmapSteps: Study PCB and shortlist nursing programs early.
Prepare for AIIMS Nursing, JIPMER Nursing, or state nursing entrance tests.
Complete B.Sc Nursing or GNM and finish your required registration.
Build experience in hospital wards, emergency care, or community health and then move into specializations.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 3-6 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen patient monitoring and compassion can move toward the upper end of INR 3-8 LPA.
Demand is very high across hospitals, community health centres, and home care services in India.
TopColleges: Rajkumari Amrit Kaur College of Nursing

Name: Software Engineer
Description: Build apps, websites, and enterprise systems using programming, testing, and product thinking.
EducationPath: Choose PCM or computer-related subjects, complete B.Tech/B.E./BCA/B.Sc CS, and build projects, internships, and coding skills.
RoadmapSteps: Choose PCM or computer-related subjects and start coding early.
Prepare for JEE Main, BITSAT, or strong university admissions.
Complete a CS-focused degree while building projects, internships, and a GitHub portfolio.
Build experience through internships, open-source work, and entry-level developer roles before moving into specializations.

Professionals who strengthen programming and problem-solving can move toward the upper end of INR 5-30 LPA.

Name: Data Scientist
Description: Use statistics, machine learning, and business understanding to turn data into decisions.
EducationPath: Take PCM, complete engineering, statistics, economics, or computer science, then build analytics and ML expertise.
RoadmapSteps: Choose PCM/PCMB or another route with strong Mathematics and build statistics and programming foundations.
Complete a degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics, or a related quantitative field.
Build Python, SQL, statistics, machine learning, and portfolio skills through projects and internships.
Start in data analytics, data science, or ML roles and progress into advanced data-science specializations.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 8-11 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen statistics and Python and SQL can move toward the upper end of INR 8-28 LPA.
Demand is very high across analytics firms, fintech, and technology companies in India.

Name: Civil Engineer
Description: Plan and execute roads, bridges, housing, and infrastructure projects.
EducationPath: Study PCM, complete B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering, and gain site, design, or project management experience.
RoadmapSteps: Study PCM and explore core engineering fundamentals.
Prepare for JEE Main, state engineering CETs, or relevant university admissions.
Complete a civil engineering degree and learn design tools, estimation, and project basics.
Build experience on sites, in design offices, or public infrastructure projects; consider GATE later for postgraduate study or selected public-sector pathways.

Professionals who strengthen structural planning and AutoCAD can move toward the upper end of INR 4-12 LPA.

Name: Architect
Description: Design buildings and spaces that balance function, safety, and aesthetics.
EducationPath: Study PCM, qualify architecture entrance tests, complete B.Arch, and build a design portfolio and practical training.
RoadmapSteps: Take 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics plus an eligible third subject under the current architecture admission rules, and develop drawing, visualisation, and design thinking.
Prepare for NATA or the applicable JEE route for B.Arch admissions and verify the latest eligibility rules before applying.
Complete the 5-year B.Arch with studio work, architectural software, practical training, and design projects.

Complete the required practical/professional steps for architectural practice and begin in an architecture studio, consultancy, planning, or related design role before progressing to independent or senior practice.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 4-7 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen design thinking and CAD software can move toward the upper end of INR 4-14 LPA.
Demand is high across architecture studios, real estate firms, and planning consultancies in India.
TopColleges: Sir J J College of Architecture

Name: Chartered Accountant
Description: Handle auditing, taxation, compliance, and financial reporting for businesses and individuals.
EducationPath: Take Commerce, register with ICAI after Class 12, clear Foundation, Intermediate, Articleship, and Final exams.
RoadmapSteps: Take Commerce and build strong accounting and economics basics.
Register for CA Foundation and understand the ICAI exam path early.
Clear Foundation, Intermediate, complete articleship, and finish Final.
Use articleship and networking to enter audit, tax, finance, or independent practice.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 7-10 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen accounting and taxation can move toward the upper end of INR 7-25 LPA.
Demand is very high across CA firms, corporate finance teams, and advisory practice in India.

Name: Investment Banker
Description: Support fundraising, mergers, valuations, and strategic financial transactions.
EducationPath: Take Commerce or PCM, complete BBA, B.Com, Economics, or MBA Finance, and build finance, valuation, and Excel skills.
RoadmapSteps: Take Commerce or PCM and build strong quantitative and finance basics.
Prepare for CUET, top commerce programs, and later CAT or MBA pathways if needed.
Complete a strong finance-focused degree and learn valuation, Excel, and business communication.
Build internships in finance, consulting, or corporate strategy before targeting analyst roles in investment banking.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 10-13 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen financial modelling and valuation can move toward the upper end of INR 10-35 LPA.
Demand is high across investment banks, advisory firms, and corporate finance teams in India.

Name: Business Analyst
Description: Translate business needs into process and product improvements using data and stakeholder input.
EducationPath: Take Commerce, Science, or Humanities, complete a business or technology degree, and learn analytics, documentation, and domain workflows.
RoadmapSteps: Choose a stream that supports business, analytics, or technology skills.
Prepare for strong business or technology degree programs through CUET or other entrance routes.
Complete graduation while learning Excel, SQL, documentation, and problem-structuring.
Build internships in operations, analytics, product, or consulting before moving into analyst roles.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 6-9 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen requirement analysis and Excel and SQL can move toward the upper end of INR 6-18 LPA.
Demand is very high across IT firms, banks, and consulting companies in India.
TopColleges: Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies

Name: Financial Planner
Description: Advise clients on savings, insurance, investments, and long-term wealth goals.
EducationPath: Choose Commerce, complete B.Com/BBA/Economics, and pursue NISM, CFP, or investment advisory certifications.
RoadmapSteps: Choose Commerce and strengthen economics, maths, and personal finance basics.
Prepare for strong business programs and certifications like CFP or NISM.
Complete graduation and add investment or advisory certifications.
Build experience in banking or wealth advisory and gradually move into client portfolios and independent planning.

Professionals who strengthen investment planning and client advisory can move toward the upper end of INR 4-15 LPA.
Demand is high across banks, wealth management firms, and advisory practice in India.

Name: Marketing Specialist
Description: Plan, execute, and measure marketing campaigns across digital, content, brand, and performance channels.
EducationPath: Choose any stream, then pursue marketing, business, commerce, media, or communication education and build analytics skills.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream and build communication, creativity, and interest in brands and customer behaviour.
Complete an undergraduate course in marketing, business, commerce, media, communication, or a related field.
Build campaign, content, analytics, and digital marketing skills through projects and internships.
Start as a marketing or digital marketing specialist and progress later into campaign, brand, or marketing management.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 6-9 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen brand strategy and digital marketing can move toward the upper end of INR 6-20 LPA.
Demand is very high across brands, agencies, and e-commerce companies in India.

Name: Supply Chain Analyst
Description: Plan and analyse procurement, inventory, logistics, and supply operations across a business.
EducationPath: Complete an undergraduate degree in commerce, business, economics, engineering, logistics, or a related field and build operations and analytics skills.
RoadmapSteps: Choose a stream that supports your interest in business, mathematics, operations, or technology.
Complete an undergraduate degree in commerce, business, economics, engineering, logistics, or a related field.
Build skills in supply planning, procurement, inventory, Excel, and data analysis through projects and internships.
Start as a supply chain, procurement, logistics, or operations analyst and progress into supply chain management with experience.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 6-9 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen operations planning and vendor coordination can move toward the upper end of INR 6-18 LPA.
Demand is high across manufacturing, retail, e-commerce, and logistics firms in India.

Name: Lawyer
Description: Advise clients, interpret laws, draft legal documents, and represent matters in courts and tribunals.
EducationPath: Choose Arts, Commerce, or Science, clear law entrance tests, complete a 5-year integrated law degree or 3-year LLB, and enroll with a bar council.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream and start building reading, writing, and reasoning skills.
Prepare for CLAT, AILET, or other law entrance exams.
Complete a 5-year integrated law degree or 3-year LLB and take part in moots, research, and internships.
Build courtroom, chamber, or corporate legal experience before moving into litigation, advisory, or niche practice areas.

Professionals who strengthen legal reasoning and research can move toward the upper end of INR 5-20 LPA.
Demand is high across law firms, courts, chambers, and corporate legal teams in India.

Name: Advocate
Description: Represent clients in courts and legal proceedings, prepare legal documents, conduct legal research, and build a professional practice in litigation or other areas of advocacy.
EducationPath: Any stream can lead to law. After Class 12, complete a 5-year integrated LL.B. programme, or complete a graduation degree followed by a 3-year LL.B. programme.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream in Classes 11-12 and build strong reading, writing, reasoning, communication, and current-affairs skills.
After Class 12, pursue a 5-year integrated LL.B. through an appropriate law admission route, or complete graduation first and then pursue a 3-year LL.B.
Complete the LL.B., develop practical skills through internships, moot courts, legal research, drafting, and exposure to court proceedings.
Complete the applicable bar-enrolment and All India Bar Examination requirements under the current rules, then begin practice under experienced advocates or in a law firm.
Build experience in litigation and legal drafting, develop a specialization, and progress toward independent advocacy and a professional legal practice.
SalaryInsights: Income varies widely based on experience, location, practice area, employer, client base, and whether the advocate is salaried or independently practising.
Early-career advocates often focus on learning, court exposure, drafting, research, and building a professional network before income becomes more predictable.
TopColleges: Faculty of Law, University of Delhi

Name: Psychologist
Description: Study behavior and mental health and support clients through assessment and therapy.
EducationPath: Take any stream, complete B.A./B.Sc. Psychology, then pursue M.A./M.Sc. Psychology and supervised practice or specialization.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream and strengthen communication, observation, and empathy.
Prepare for psychology programs through CUET, institute tests, or university admissions.
Complete a psychology degree and then move into a master's program with supervised practice.
Build counselling, assessment, or therapy experience before specializing in clinical, counselling, school, or industrial psychology.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 4-7 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen active listening and assessment can move toward the upper end of INR 4-12 LPA.
Demand is very high across hospitals, schools, universities, and private practice in India.

Name: Journalist
Description: Research, report, and publish stories across print, television, and digital media.
EducationPath: Choose Arts or any stream, complete journalism, mass communication, or media studies, and build a writing and reporting portfolio.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream and start writing, reading news, and following current affairs.
Prepare for media and communication programs through CUET, IIMC, or university routes.
Complete journalism or mass communication studies while building a reporting portfolio.
Build internships in newsrooms, digital media, or broadcast before taking on beats or specialist reporting roles.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 3-6 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen reporting and writing can move toward the upper end of INR 3-10 LPA.
Demand is steady across newsrooms, digital media companies, and broadcast networks in India.

Name: Graphic Designer
Description: Create visual identities, campaigns, layouts, and digital assets for brands and products.
EducationPath: Take Arts or any stream, learn design fundamentals, complete a design degree or diploma, and build a strong portfolio.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream and start building visual taste through design exercises and observations.
Prepare for design school admissions or diploma pathways like NID DAT or UCEED.
Complete a design program while building skills in typography, layout, branding, and Adobe tools.
Build a portfolio through freelance, internships, and agency work before moving into brand, product, or studio design roles.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 3-6 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen typography and Adobe tools can move toward the upper end of INR 3-12 LPA.
Demand is high across creative agencies, brand teams, and freelance practice in India.

Name: UI/UX Designer
Description: Design digital experiences that are intuitive, attractive, and aligned with user needs.
EducationPath: Study any stream, build design fundamentals, learn UX research and interface design, and develop a product design portfolio.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream and build an eye for digital experiences and usability.
Prepare for design college admissions or portfolio-based opportunities.
Learn UX research, wireframing, interaction design, and prototyping through courses and projects.
Build a strong case-study portfolio and internship experience before targeting product design or UX roles.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 6-9 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen user research and prototyping can move toward the upper end of INR 6-22 LPA.
Demand is very high across product companies, design studios, and startups in India.

Name: Fashion Designer
Description: Create clothing lines, styling concepts, and fashion collections for brands or labels.
EducationPath: Choose Arts or any stream, complete fashion design studies, and build a portfolio through internships and live projects.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream and start building sketching, styling, and trend awareness.
Prepare for NIFT, NID, or portfolio-based fashion school admissions.
Complete a fashion design program and build collections, technical skills, and internships.
Create a portfolio and industry network before entering fashion houses, retail brands, or launching your own label.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 4-7 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen sketching and trend awareness can move toward the upper end of INR 4-14 LPA.
Demand is high across fashion houses, retail brands, and independent labels in India.

Name: Hotel Operations Executive
Description: Coordinate hotel operations and guest services across areas such as front office, food and beverage, and property operations.
EducationPath: Any stream can lead to hospitality; pursue hotel management, hospitality, tourism, or business education and gain practical training.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream and build communication, service, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
Prepare for NCHM JEE, CUET, or relevant hospitality institute admissions.
Complete hotel management or hospitality education with practical training and internships.
Start in front office, food and beverage, guest relations, or hotel operations and progress toward supervisory and management roles.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 4-7 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen guest service and operations can move toward the upper end of INR 4-12 LPA.
Demand is high across hotels, resorts, travel hospitality, and food service chains in India.

Name: Interior Designer
Description: Plan interiors for homes, offices, and commercial spaces with functional and aesthetic design.
EducationPath: Study Arts, Science, or Commerce, complete interior design training, and build a portfolio with practical design work.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream and start developing spatial sense, sketching, and design software interest.
Prepare for design school admissions or portfolio-based interior design programs.
Complete interior design training and build project work around layouts, materials, and visualization.
Build a portfolio with residential or commercial projects before moving into studio, real estate, or freelance practice.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 4-7 LPA, depending on city, training, and internship exposure.
Professionals who strengthen space planning and design software can move toward the upper end of INR 4-13 LPA.
Demand is high across design studios, real estate firms, and consultancy practice in India.

Name: IAS Officer
Description: Lead district administration, policy execution, and public governance through the civil services.
EducationPath: Complete graduation in any stream, prepare for UPSC Civil Services, clear Prelims, Mains, and Interview, then complete training.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream in Classes 11-12 and build strong reading, writing, reasoning, and current-affairs habits.
Complete a recognized undergraduate degree in any discipline; no specific school stream is required for UPSC Civil Services.
After graduation, prepare for the UPSC Civil Services Examination: Prelims → Mains → Personality Test, with an optional subject and sustained answer-writing practice.
If allocated to IAS, complete foundation and professional training, then begin field and administrative postings and progress through district, state, and policy responsibilities.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 8-11 LPA, depending on posting, allowances, and training stage.
Professionals who strengthen public administration and decision-making can move toward the upper end of INR 8-18 LPA.
Demand remains very high because civil services roles are highly competitive and stable in India.

Name: IPS Officer
Description: Lead policing, internal security, law enforcement, and crime prevention operations.
EducationPath: Finish graduation in any discipline, qualify UPSC Civil Services, and complete IPS academy and field training.
RoadmapSteps: Choose any stream in Classes 11-12 and build discipline, communication, current-affairs awareness, and physical fitness.
Complete a recognized undergraduate degree in any discipline and maintain the physical standards required for the intended service route.
After graduation, prepare for the UPSC Civil Services Examination: Prelims → Mains → Personality Test.
If allocated to IPS, complete professional police training and field attachments, then build experience through law-enforcement, investigation, intelligence, and command postings.
SalaryInsights: Entry-level opportunities often begin around INR 8-11 LPA, depending on posting, allowances, and training stage.
Professionals who strengthen leadership under pressure and crisis management can move toward the upper end of INR 8-18 LPA.
Demand remains very high because IPS roles are prestigious, stable, and highly competitive in India.

Name: Defence Officer
Description: Serve in the Army, Navy, or Air Force as a commissioned officer in operations, strategy, and leadership roles.

Clear written exams, SSB, and medical stages and complete academy training.
Build a long-term career through field service, leadership experience, and specialized defence tracks.

Professionals who strengthen physical fitness and leadership can move toward the upper end of INR 7-18 LPA.
Demand is high across the Army, Navy, and Air Force, though selection is highly competitive.

Name: Commercial Pilot
Description: Fly passenger or cargo aircraft and manage safe navigation and cockpit operations.
EducationPath: Take PCM, obtain Class 2 and Class 1 medicals, complete flying training, build flight hours, and secure DGCA licenses.

Complete flying training, required flight hours, and license milestones.
Build cockpit experience through regional, charter, or cadet pathways before moving into larger commercial airline roles.

Professionals who strengthen situational awareness and communication can move toward the upper end of INR 12-45 LPA.
Demand is high across airlines, cargo operators, and charter aviation in India.

Prepare for biotechnology or life-science degree admissions.
Complete a biotech-focused degree with lab work, research exposure, and projects.

Professionals who strengthen laboratory techniques and research aptitude can move toward the upper end of INR 4-14 LPA.
Demand is high across biotech companies, research institutes, and pharma or agri-tech labs in India.

Name: Agricultural Scientist
Description: Improve crop yield, soil health, irrigation, and sustainable farming systems through research and field science.
EducationPath: Study PCB or PCM, complete B.Sc Agriculture or related degree, and pursue research, agronomy, plant science, or extension work.

Complete B.Sc Agriculture or a related agricultural/life-science degree through the applicable university admission route.
Build fieldwork and research experience and pursue an M.Sc/M.Tech or PhD when the intended scientist/research role requires advanced specialization.
Enter agricultural research, agronomy, plant science, soil science, extension, agri-tech, or government research roles and progress into advanced scientific positions.

Professionals who strengthen agronomy and field research can move toward the upper end of INR 5-15 LPA.
Demand is high across agriculture universities, research centres, agri-tech firms, and government departments in India.

Name: Physiotherapist
Description: Help patients recover movement, reduce pain, and improve rehabilitation after injury or illness.
EducationPath: Take PCB, complete BPT, gain internship experience, and pursue specialization in sports, neuro, or orthopaedic rehab if needed.

Prepare for BPT or allied health admissions through NEET-UG or university routes.
Complete BPT with internship and strong anatomy, rehab, and patient care exposure.

Professionals who strengthen rehabilitation planning and patient motivation can move toward the upper end of INR 4-10 LPA.
Demand is very high across hospitals, rehab centres, sports clinics, and private practice in India.

Prepare for allied health entrance tests and university admissions.
Complete BOT with supervised training and practical therapy exposure.

Demand is high across hospitals, special schools, and rehab centres in India.

Demand is high across animation studios, gaming companies, and media production houses in India.

Professionals who strengthen community outreach and advocacy can move toward the upper end of INR 3-9 LPA.
Demand is high across NGOs, CSR foundations, and welfare departments in India.

Name: Content Creator

Prepare for portfolio-based media opportunities or communication programs if you want formal training.
Learn video editing, branding, scripting, analytics, and platform strategy through projects.

Professionals who strengthen storytelling and video editing can move toward the upper end of INR 3-20 LPA.
Demand is very high across creator economy platforms, agencies, and brand collaboration work in India.

Complete D.Pharm, B.Pharm, or Pharm.D from a recognized institute.

Hospital, clinical research, regulatory, and pharmaceutical-industry roles may offer higher growth.
